title: Report source-specific cheat master references
changes: Report bounded provenance-specific master links in readonly cheat show and assumed-plaintext inspection, distinguishing missing, invalid, self, unknown, mismatched-source and same-source references without selecting a dependency.
Include format and region metadata equality and the number of matching source records; preserve the original catalog and entry.
validation: Isolated Windows GNU test and runtime builds passed; a focused synthetic Wine test covered all reference states, and final Wine CLI checks confirmed show/inspect agreement, the operation description and unchanged source.
Operation inventory and Atlas inventory checks passed; no real catalog payload or guest execution was tested.
limitations: A source match does not verify device, encryption, master semantics or ROM behavior; recursive dependencies, decryption and guest application remain unimplemented. Native Windows and Linux runtime were not tested.
